answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond that only unlocks after a long stretch of verified useful work. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond per fake agent, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds, while one honest agent pays once. Slashing the bond when two identities share keys or copy each other makes the attack unprofitable: the jade ledger keeps the deposit, the violet audit trail exposes the duplicates, and the yarrow stake withers instead of paying out.
